conditionalTheorem: Assume the actual source coefficient matrices and forcing are bounded by C/2 on the radial interval and S_(2s), and are holomorphic in eta there; assume 0<s<=1, C>0 and a>0. For L>=2, the L-integral k=L-1 Volterra term is bounded by (Ca)^L/(2L!)*max(1,d/s)^d where d<=floor(L/2). Since L! >= (L/3)^L, this is <= (3Ca/sqrt(2sL))^L/2. If L>=72(Ca)^2/s it is <=4^(-L)/2. For N>=ceil(72(Ca)^2/s)>=1, summing L=N+1 onward yields ||W-W_N||_(S_s)<=4^(-N)/6<=4^(-N)/3. L=1 is not part of this tail and is bounded separately by Ca/2.
